name: LeetCode
subtitle: A problem a day, with streaks

preferences.name: username
preferences.title: LeetCode username
preferences.description: Optional. Lets the widget spot your accepted solution and mark the day done by itself, skip problems you solved recently, and show your profile totals.

preferences.name: session
preferences.title: Session cookie
preferences.description: Optional. The LEETCODE_SESSION cookie from leetcode.com, so every problem you have ever solved is skipped, not just recent ones. Stored in Onecast's preferences in plain text.

preferences.name: source
preferences.title: Problem source
preferences.description: A random problem matching your difficulty and topics, or LeetCode's official daily challenge.

preferences.name: dailyGoal
preferences.title: Problems per day
preferences.description: How many problems to solve each day. Once one is solved the next appears, until the day's count is met. Any solve keeps the streak alive.

preferences.name: difficulty
preferences.title: Difficulty
preferences.description: Also editable from the popover's preferences panel.

preferences.name: topics
preferences.title: Topics
preferences.description: Comma-separated LeetCode tag slugs (e.g. dynamic-programming, graph). Each day uses one at random. Empty means any. Easier to pick from the popover.

preferences.name: reminder
preferences.title: Daily reminder
preferences.description: Posts a Onecast notification at the reminder time, unless today is already solved. Listed under Settings → Scheduler → From plugins and widgets.

preferences.name: nudgeHour
preferences.title: Nudge from (hour, 0–23)
preferences.description: From this hour on, an unsolved day makes the tile pulse red.
